reference_sql:
WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(*) AS n_products, COALESCE(SUM(pu.units), 0) AS units
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.parent_category
alternatives: SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS n_products, COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity), 0) AS units FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.parent_category

WITH product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM order_lines GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.parent_category, COUNT(p.product_id) AS n_products, SUM(COALESCE(pu.units, 0)) AS units FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY 1
